analysis:
Reviewed the units in this batch: the Makefile (base and head), docs/README.md (patch, base and head text) and docs/architecture/cache-aware-routing.md (patch). All changes are non-runtime. The Makefile adds two test invocations to provider-test (scripts/test-stage-swiftpm-resource-bundles.py, head line 71) and two to benchmark-wrapper-test (scripts/benchmarks radix forward shapes test and reports/runtime-kv-path-2026-10-09/qualification/test_curate_runs.py, head lines 83-84). These are local developer/CI test commands with no new network surface, secrets or privilege. docs/README.md only bumps the date and adds an index link to architecture/kv-cache-quantization.md. cache-aware-routing.md adds a paragraph saying quantized KV slots advertise only the exact complete checkpoint contract, that native and packed namespaces differ, that legacy resident-page and native tensor snapshot formats are bypassed for packed precision, and that proof/receipt authority is unchanged.

Cross-file note for later passes: the doc text implies provider-side changes (packed KV checkpoints in the SSD cache, relevant to T-041 and SEC-035) that are not in this batch. Those files were not provided, so this batch gives no evidence about them. Integration should check whether the packed checkpoint path preserves the DBK3 HMAC lookup tags, the GCM AAD, salt scoping, the 30-minute TTL and KEK-wipe purge, and that the cache namespace and format identity are bound into AAD/lookup so native and packed entries cannot be confused. The new kv-cache-quantization.md was not supplied. No security regression is evidenced in these units; only the doc claim of unchanged proof/receipt authority is unverified.
